SELECT s.snum, s.sisbn, s.sname, s.scategory, s.spublisher, s.sauthor, s.samount, s.sprice, s.sdate, si.stocknum, si.stockimage FROM ( SELECT snum, sisbn, sname, scategory, spublisher, sauthor, samount, sprice, sdate, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY snum desc) AS row_num FROM stock
sisbn like '%' || #{searchValue} || '%'
sname like '%' || #{searchValue} || '%'
scategory like '%' || #{searchValue} || '%'
spublisher like '%' || #{searchValue} || '%'
sauthor like '%' || #{searchValue} || '%'
) s LEFT JOIN ( SELECT stocknum, stockimage FROM( SELECT stocknum, stockimage, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY stocknum ORDER BY stockimage) AS rn FROM STOCKIMAGE ) WHERE rn=1) si ON s.snum=si.stocknum WHERE s.row_num BETWEEN #{begin} AND #{end} ORDER BY s.snum desc

scategory like '%' || #{searchValue} || '%'

SELECT s.snum, s.sisbn, s.sname, s.scategory, s.spublisher, s.sauthor, s.samount, s.sprice, s.sdate, si.stockimage FROM ( SELECT snum, sisbn, sname, scategory, spublisher, sauthor, samount, sprice, sdate, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY snum DESC) AS row_num FROM stock WHERE membernum = #{membernum}
AND sisbn LIKE '%' || #{searchValue} || '%'
AND sname LIKE '%' || #{searchValue} || '%'
AND scategory LIKE '%' || #{searchValue} || '%'
AND spublisher LIKE '%' || #{searchValue} || '%'
AND sauthor LIKE '%' || #{searchValue} || '%'
) s LEFT JOIN ( SELECT stocknum, stockimage FROM ( SELECT stocknum,stockimage,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY stocknum ORDER BY stockimage) rn FROM STOCKIMAGE ) WHERE rn = 1 ) si ON s.snum = si.stocknum WHERE s.row_num BETWEEN #{begin} AND #{end} ORDER BY s.snum DESC
